_comment: Photo manifest. Drop .jpg files into /images/ and list them here. 'tab' may be a string or an array; the Gallery renders every entry whose tab includes 'gallery'. 'size' is "" | "wide" | "tall" and controls the asymmetric grid. 'alt' is optional and falls back to 'caption'. Entries whose file is missing render as a labelled placeholder frame — the four trailing entries below are outstanding shots held open on purpose.

images.caption: The ridge from above — the club below, the hills beyond
images.alt: Aerial view of 56 Capilano Drive on its wooded hilltop parcel, with the fairways of Marin Country Club below and the ridge line beyond.

images.caption: Approach from Capilano Drive
images.alt: The front elevation of the 1963 residence, its butterfly rooflines rising above a bark-mulched entry court and stepped stone path.

images.caption: The residence on the ridge, from above
images.alt: Aerial view of the residence set into the crown of the ridge, with open hills behind and the club grounds below to the west.

images.caption: From the terrace — the valley and the hills beyond
images.alt: The view out from the terrace at 56 Capilano Drive, over the treetops to the open hills across the valley.

images.caption: Marin Country Club — the fairways below
images.alt: The fairways, greens and bunkers of Marin Country Club seen from above, with the wooded hillside rising behind them.

images.caption: Pool, terrace and lawn, the club beyond
images.alt: The pool, terrace and lawn behind the residence, with the fairways of Marin Country Club immediately beyond the tree line.

images.caption: The 1.13-acre parcel, hilltop siting
images.alt: Overhead view of the full parcel — the residence, its circular drive, the pool terrace and the rear lawn.

images.caption: Primary bath — soaking tub set into the window wall
images.alt: A freestanding soaking tub in the primary bath, set into a wall of wood-framed windows looking out to the hills.
